verdict.rationale: Fivetran publishes a usage-based (MAR) pricing model and public pricing page allowing rough cost estimation, but multiple independent user reports concretely contradict the 'predictable' claim — describing billing spikes, inflated row counts requiring extra charges, and difficulty estimating costs before setup. Missing for 10: a documented cost calculator/estimator for pre-connection sizing, and resolution of the inflated-row-count dispute.
